## What this region is

Presenting an enrolled Signet to Kingdom: an access token plus an ES256 DPoP proof from the EC P-256 device key, sent through SignetClient, and the wire shape of the Signet itself (owner, recipient, lifecycle, proposal).

## What it exists for

- Name or validate who owns a Signet
- Validate a Signet's proposed terms
- Make a device key and prove possession of it
- Validate a key's JWK
- Send a call to Kingdom as an enrolled Signet
- Validate what SignetClient sends and gets back

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- ask Kingdom for a Signet and wait until someone approves it → obtaining-and-holding
- save the key and credential with owner-only permissions → obtaining-and-holding
- check whether this grant allows commits.read → grants-and-operations
- open a live stream of a conversation thread as a member → agent-conversations
- keep a cached describe for each held Signet → obtaining-and-holding
